description: 外部验证 category runbook 契约。该 gate 消费 external validation closure work queue，为每个 category 生成 operator 可执行 runbook：required credential、operator command、proof-ref artifact pattern、redaction rule、expiry policy、failure rollback 和 closure condition。该 gate 不连接真实外部系统，不把 runbook ready 等同于 live passed。

runbookPolicy.shipGate: blocked until category live evidence, proof-ref bundle and audit review are all complete
runbookPolicy.commandPolicy: operator commands must be local repository scripts or documented external operator actions without raw URL or secret values
runbookPolicy.redactionPolicy: runbook and summary must not include real endpoint URL, token, secret, DSN, private key, production payload, user input or report body

privacyBoundary: Category runbooks 只保存脱敏命令模板、proof-ref artifact pattern、owner/category、work item id、occurrence count、redaction/expiry/rollback/closure policy；不得保存真实 URL、token、secret、DSN、私钥、生产日志、trace payload、报告正文、用户输入或外部账号数据。
nonClaims: Does not prove any external live validation has passed.
Does not replace category-specific live gates.
Does not replace proof-ref evidence verification.
Does not authorize production credential use.
